title: F06: Upload + review/correct UI, corrections, confirm
milestone: M5 API + UI
labels: frontend, backend
---
## Goal
Scenario 1 end to end: upload a photo, review and correct the extraction, confirm the expense.

**Depends on:** F05
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`

## Scope
- **Backend:** `PATCH /expenses/{id}`, `POST /expenses/{id}/confirm`, `DELETE /expenses/{id}` (the F06 stubs). Editing semantics per decision 0018: `ai` → `ai_corrected`; an edited field leaves `unreadable_fields`; an item's stored category stays unless `category` is sent or the description changed; a foreign item id is `422 validation_error`; editing a confirmed expense un-confirms it and its receipt goes back to `extracted` in one transaction. No contract change; `docs/openapi.json` must not drift.
- **Frontend:** `index.html` (upload, progress, recent receipts) and `review.html` (image beside the form; failed, extracting, extracted and confirmed states), `js/api.js` as in `api-client.md`. The Expenses page moves to F10.
- F07 isn't built, so every extracted item is `uncategorized`; the category dropdown is how the user makes an expense confirmable. The choice is stored on the item only.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The user can run the whole of scenario 1 in the UI
- [ ] Confirm is refused while any item is uncategorised (button disabled and `422 uncategorized_items`)
- [ ] AI-generated values are labelled (client-side badge on merchant, date, currency and total, decision 0018; no per-item badge, decision 0019)
- [ ] The form shows merchant, date, currency, total and items with name, quantity, amount and category (0019)
- [ ] **Save & confirm** saves, confirms and returns home; a refused confirm stays on the page with the reason. **Save draft** saves and returns home (0019)
- [ ] Extraction (prompt v2): line totals per item, no unit price, subtotal or tax; date as printed and parsed by code; Pfand charged positive, Pfand returned negative, both categorised `deposit` (0019)
- [ ] Flagged fields and uncategorised items are highlighted, with the flag's message, not by colour alone
- [ ] Every field stays editable whatever the review status; flags and the review status are recomputed after each create or edit (`domain.confidence.assess`) and re-rendered after Save
- [ ] A `null` required field (merchant, date, total, item description/amount) is shown as "unknown, please fill in"; optional nulls show a quiet "–"
- [ ] A `not_a_receipt` receipt says the image wasn't recognised as a receipt and offers Retry or Enter manually with an empty form
- [ ] API tests for PATCH, confirm and delete, including the lifecycle transitions `extracted ↔ confirmed`
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_frontend_static.py`: no `innerHTML`-style sinks, `fetch` only in `api.js`, the JS category list matches the contract, every `/api` path in the JS exists in `docs/openapi.json`
